name: ERO Ragnarok Offline 4
source:
Chris breaks out from the jail, but gets in adventurers trap, which triggers another cycle of revenge. She summons monsters attacking adventurers and insulting women. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]

克莉丝越狱后，却落入冒险者的陷阱，新一轮复仇就此展开。她召唤魔物袭击冒险者，并凌辱女性。
